intent: Inspect and refactor CorrelationContext without changing the ast_hints surface or the tests' behavior (never seal or finalize a type another unit stubs; no magic numbers, no blocking calls, no raw logger calls beyond the claimed step logs). Unit contract: Shared static-only holder (all members bound static in the table) that is the single owner of the correlation key literals requestId, the header X-Request-Id and the absent marker UNCORRELATED. Correlation lives in the Reactor Context and in the audit record's correlationId field; no MDC and no context-propagation library is used, so log lines do not carry the id (declared).
